privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Farmear Aura
privacy.desc: farmearaura.com: the aura quiz runs in your browser and never leaves your device. The vote duels do use a server, and the site uses Google Analytics. Here's exactly what's processed.
privacy.lead: This site doesn't require an account, a password, or any personal data to use. The aura quiz runs entirely in your browser. The vote duels do connect to a server to build the live ranking, and we use Google Analytics to understand traffic. Below we detail exactly what's processed in each case.
sections: Who's responsible
Site owner: Farmear Aura SRL, Argentina.
Contact email: hola@farmearaura.com.
What data gets processed
When you take the quiz, the answers you pick and the name or handle you type in are used only to calculate your score and draw your card. That processing happens entirely on your own device:

ul: It's never sent to any server.
It's never saved in cookies or browser storage.
It disappears the moment you close or reload the page.

sections: The site doesn't support photo uploads. Your card's avatar is an emoji you pick from a list.
The card you share

Your card image is generated on your device and never uploaded anywhere. If you use the share button, your operating system hands that image off to whatever app you pick (TikTok, Instagram, WhatsApp, or another). From that point on, that app's own privacy policy applies, not ours.
The vote duels

The aura duels (the pages where you vote on which character or celebrity wins) work differently from the quiz: your vote is sent to our server and stored in a database, because that's how the live ranking everyone sees gets built.

ul: What gets stored per vote: which option won, which lost, and when. We don't store your name, your handle, or anything you typed into the quiz.

We also process a version of your IP address run through a one-way cryptographic hash, never the IP itself. We use it only to stop someone from voting hundreds of times a minute and skewing the ranking. That hash can't be reversed to figure out who you are, and it's never linked to any name or account.

sections: The counter of how many duels you've voted in (so we can flag when you hit 5 or 10) lives only in your own browser (localStorage) and is never sent to us.
Third parties
Even though the site doesn't collect data, loading any web page means your device talks to whoever's serving it. In this case:

ul: Cloudflare hosts the site and the duels server. Like any server, it processes your IP address to respond to requests and for security purposes.

Google Analytics (GA4) gives us traffic stats: which pages get visited, from what kind of device and approximate country, plus events like finishing the quiz or voting in a duel. Google processes your IP address in truncated form to estimate your location and may use cookies (see the Cookie Policy) to distinguish visits. That data is also governed by Google's own privacy policy.

sections: The site's typefaces are hosted on our own server, not on Google Fonts, so they don't create any extra third-party connection.
Minors

A good chunk of the people who visit this site are teenagers. That's exactly why it's built to need no data at all: it doesn't ask for your age, your real name, your email, or photos, and there's no way to sign up.
If you're a parent or guardian with questions about how the site works, reach out and we'll answer.
Your rights

Data protection law gives you the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. The aura quiz doesn't store anything of yours, so there's nothing to manage there. The duels store your vote along with a hash of your IP that we can't tie back to your identity, so we can't locate or delete an individual record on request, but you can simply stop voting in duels at any time without it affecting the rest of the site. For data processed by Google Analytics, you can manage your activity through your Google account or block analytics cookies (see the Cookie Policy). Any question or request, write to us and we'll get back to you.
Changes to this policy

This page was updated on August 31, 2026 to reflect the addition of Google Analytics and the database-backed duels system, neither of which existed when the earlier version of this text was written. If we ever add advertising or any other data use, we'll update this page before turning it on.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy | Farmear Aura
cookies.desc: farmearaura.com uses Google Analytics cookies to measure traffic. It doesn't use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Here's exactly what loads and how to block it.
cookies.lead: This site uses analytics cookies (Google Analytics) and no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. You can block them without the site breaking — here's how.
sections: What a cookie is

A cookie is a small file a site saves in your browser to remember something between visits: that you're logged in, what language you prefer, or, very often, which pages you visited so it can show you ads later.
What this site uses
The aura quiz doesn't use any cookie of its own: your score and name live in the page's memory and vanish the moment you reload it.

ul: Google Analytics cookies (like _ga and _ga_<ID>): let Google tell visits apart to measure traffic and which pages or features get used, like finishing the quiz or voting in a duel. Google controls how long these last, typically up to two years, under its own policy.
localStorage on the duels pages: we store, only in your browser, how many times you've voted, so we can show you a milestone message at 5 or 10 votes. It never leaves your device.

sections: The provider hosting the site may, in certain circumstances, set a strictly necessary security cookie (for example, to tell automated traffic apart from real visitors). That kind of cookie can't be used to profile you or serve ads.
How to control them anyway

Every browser lets you view, block, and delete cookies from its privacy settings. You can also install Google's Analytics opt-out browser add-on so no site can measure you with that tool. Blocking analytics cookies won't break this site: the quiz and duels keep working exactly the same, we just stop seeing that visit in the stats.
If this changes

This page was updated on August 31, 2026 to reflect the addition of Google Analytics cookies. If we ever add advertising cookies, a real consent notice — with the option to decline — will appear before anything loads.

about.title: About Us | Farmear Aura
about.desc: What farmearaura.com is, how the content gets written, and why the quiz doesn't measure anything real.
about.lead: farmearaura.com is an aura points calculator and a reference guide to aura farming, the meme that went from TikTok to half the internet's everyday vocabulary in 2025.
sections: What we do

Two things. First, a seven-scenario quiz that spits out a score and a shareable card. Second, a guide that explains where the term comes from, how the points system works, and what the phrases around it actually mean.

The quiz exists because it's fun. The guide exists because when someone searches what farming aura means, almost everything they find is articles copied from each other that don't cite where any of it came from.
How we write the content

ul: We verify the meme's origin against primary sources and reputable outlets, and cite them at the end of the guide.
We separate what's documented from what's just internet convention. If there's no official point scale, we say so instead of making one up.
We correct mistakes. If you spot an error, write to us and we'll fix it.

sections: What this isn't

It's not a personality test, not a psychological tool, and it has nothing to do with esoteric auras or color readings. Aura points aren't real: they're an internet joke, and this site treats them as one.
A low score doesn't say anything about you. It's a joke with a big number next to it.
Who's behind it
The site is run by Farmear Aura SRL out of Argentina. It's not a media company project and there's no editorial staff: it's a small site, built and maintained by one person.
Got a scenario that should be in the quiz? Send it to hola@farmearaura.com.

contact.title: Contact | Farmear Aura
contact.desc: How to get in touch with farmearaura.com: corrections, press, scenario suggestions, and privacy questions.
contact.lead: Write to us at hola@farmearaura.com. It's the only way to reach us, and a real person reads it.
sections: What to write about

ul: Corrections. If something in the guide is wrong or outdated, tell us what and why.
Scenario suggestions. The best ones in the quiz come from people who actually lived them.
Privacy. Any question about how the site works, including from parents or guardians.
Content removal. If something published affects you, tell us about it.

sections: Why there's no form

A contact form means a server that receives and stores what you type. Since the rest of the site collects zero data, adding one just for this would be contradictory. A direct email does the same job and leaves the message in your Sent folder, where you can see it.
Response time
Usually within a few days. It's a small project, not a 24/7 support team.
